last_checked_note: Scheduled 04:00 run. The 23:30 IST bulletin of 19 November (1800 UTC) is in the record at 17.1N 85.1E, severe cyclonic storm, north-north-west at 19 kmph, 240 km south of Gopalpur. Read from IMD's own products at 04:08 IST on the 20th: the ACWC Kolkata sea-area bulletin valid 21 UTC 19 Nov to 09 UTC 20 Nov states the centre at 2330 IST of the 19th near 17.1N 85.1E, and the ACWC Chennai coastal bulletin issued 2100 UTC (02:30 IST) is based on the same 1800 UTC position. The All India Weather Bulletin PDF linked from IMD's page is still the 20:30 IST issue of the 19th. No 21:00 UTC (02:30 IST) fix had been issued by 04:08 IST. No reclassification: still a severe cyclonic storm at the fix, so the descriptor stands, and the crossing forecast is unchanged at 70-80 kmph gusting 90 close to Gopalpur by noon of the 20th.

forecast.note: IMD's corridor, north Andhra Pradesh and Yanam to south Odisha, the centre closest to Gopalpur. The 20:30 IST sea-area bulletin of the 19th has it crossing as a cyclonic storm with 70-80 kmph gusting 90, weakened from the 90-100 kmph gusting 110 in the 17:30 bulletin
